I'm a proud orthorexic plant-based person so some of this may not work for you but I am a firm believer in fiber in the morning.

Bowl of raisin bran + almond milk + ground flax seed = $0.60 breakfast

A cup of old-fashioned oats + ground flax seed + 2 cups of water + 15 minutes boil = $0.25 breakfast (don't use quick or instant oatmeal...it is too processed and jacks up your blood sugar and you'll be starving an hour later)

4 or 5 spotty yellow bananas = ~$1.00 breakfast

Tomato/breakfast beans on toast with little bit of margarine and seasoning salt (Van Camps pork n beans or Van camps vegetarian beans in the US or Heinz beans in other English-speaking countries) = $1.20 breakfast

Toasted wheat bagel with cream cheese (or tofu cheese) = $0.80 breakfast

Avocado slices & tomato slice on toasted wheat topped with ground flax seed ~ $1.00 breakfast

Other ideas: If bananas are about to turn, peel and freeze and make smoothies with them later

Buckwheat + flaxseed pancakes

Tapioca pudding

Pea protein powder + fruit smoothie

Steak & Egg McBeetus with extra cheese, salt, and margarine

Chilled tears of children and the elderly

Boiled beets + salt & pepper
